propositions: Duplicate invariant comments (field-convergence fit-then-normalize, pagination-stall aborts, unmapped relations handling, value map ownership) are scattered across 4-8 sites and must be consolidated into new or amended ADRs before relocation to avoid dangling citations.

Stale or false comments exist: _backend_registry.py falsely marks select_backend as STUB (13 modules actually import it), and S2/S3/S4-not-landed notes in _backend.py and adapters/jira/backend.py no longer reflect reality.

The measured count of relocation-marker comments (6 RELOCATED VERBATIM, 6 cap-limit notes, 10 distinct files) contradicts the original claim of 28 sites; the ~970 line recovery estimate is therefore unreliable and must be replaced by actual measurement.
Comment destinations must be created (new ADRs, amendments) and committed before any comment citing them is collapsed or deleted, to prevent loss of arguments.
The reconciler subtree's comments are predominantly measured external-API facts and anti-refactor warnings that cannot be re-derived from code and must be preserved verbatim in a do_not_move list.
Reconciler tests must pass unchanged after all relocations and deletions to ensure no behaviour regression.
